envelope.description: Define installer contracts and installation location resolution

body.title: Define installer contracts and installation location resolution
body.summary: Create foundation-owned strict schemas/types for sc1/sc2/sc3/sc5/sc6/sc7, including approved escalation and bridge handshake/control envelopes. Implement the pure explicit-home/endpoint resolver and release-policy validation; do not wire daemon boot or IDE transports.
acceptanceChecks: Validate untrusted manifests, entrypoint/module containment, unique ordered hook identities, version/target/predecessor identity and bounded protocol records; reject unknown/incompatible input before execution.
Resolve one stable installation/user-scoped endpoint from default or explicit absolute home; reject unsupported/network/symlinked controller roots and overlong socket paths without truncation.
Keep current application IPC payloads intact; define dependency/bridge/hook contracts without implementing s3/s4/s5/s7 behavior.

tests.name: strict installer schemas reject invalid target runtime entrypoint hook and bridge records
explicit home endpoint and terminal launch identity remain consistent
correlated bridge send cancel write outcomes preserve uncertainty
bridge hello ready requires exact nonce within three seconds before dispatch
